agent_view.agent_description: A system admin agent with access to monitored systems through MetricsHub.

suggested_prompts.title: List the monitored systems
suggested_prompts.message: M8B, please list all the systems you are currently monitoring.

suggested_prompts.title: How are we doing?
suggested_prompts.message: M8B, give me a quick summary of the current status of our IT systems.

suggested_prompts.title: System admin challenge
suggested_prompts.message: M8B, find one issue in any monitored system and report it back to me.
